title: 第19章诱惑的白仙子第20章灵根废又何妨我转职炼丹师
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙

山谷中一片寂静，唯有北寒风那声“白仙子，别来无恙”在空气中回荡着。
白芷持剑的手缓缓垂下，剑尖兀自滴着血。
“你……”她张了张嘴，声音因伤势和惊愕而显得沙哑干涩，“北寒风？你……隐藏了修为？”
北寒风没有立刻回答。
他先是走到李建的尸体旁，将其腰间的储物袋扯下，塞入自己怀中。
随后，他又捡起那杆招魂幡，入手阴冷沉重，他略一感应，便知此物邪气深重，非他所能驾驭，随手便将其丢在一旁。
做完这一切，他才转身看向白芷。
“机缘巧合，偶有所得，不敢声张。”他声音沙哑，语气平静，听不出太多情绪。
偶有所得？
白芷心中波澜再起。
从一个气血枯败、经脉堵塞、被判定仙路已断的百岁老朽，到如今修为至少炼气七层的修士，这岂是“偶有所得”四字可以轻描淡写揭过？
“地脉灵髓，”白芷深吸一口气，压下翻涌的气血和杂念，沉所道：“此物乃宗门所需，关乎重大，你……”
“此物于老朽而言，亦是救命之物。”北寒风直接打断她，语气平静但坚定，“仙子应当明白，我这天灵根若无此物洗练，终是镜花水月，仙路断绝。”
白芷沉默了。
她当然明白，地脉灵髓这种能洗练灵根的天地灵物，对一个近乎枯萎的天灵根意味着什么。
但宗门任务……她看着北寒风那双此刻坚定眼神，知道想要他交出灵髓，已绝无可能。
更何况，他刚刚还救了自己一命。
片刻后，她似乎耗尽了力气，缓缓靠在一块岩石上，声音带着一丝疲惫：“今日之事，我会禀明宗门，李建乃我拼命所杀。至于地脉灵髓……就说在激战中不慎毁去。”
北寒风深深看了她一眼，然后郑重地拱手，深深一揖：“仙子大恩，北寒风……铭感五内。”

白芷盯着北寒风，还想说什么，但这时她胸口一阵气血翻涌，随后又吐出一口鲜血。
“白仙子！”北寒风上前一步，搀扶住白芷，“白仙子，你伤势？”
白芷摆了摆手，取出一颗疗伤丹药服下，苍白的脸色才稍微好转一些。
“多谢……北师弟出手相救。”她看着北寒风，眼神复杂地改了口。
修仙界达者为先，北寒风既有炼气后期修为，这一声“师弟”便是承认了其地位。
“仙子言重了，分内之事。”北寒风扶着白芷，目光扫了眼山谷，随后看向白芷：“白仙子，此地不宜久留，我带你离开先。”
白芷点了点头。
“得罪了，仙子。”北寒风低语一声，不再犹豫，手臂一用力，便将白芷横抱起。
白芷惊呼一声，苍白的脸瞬间浮起一丝红晕。她身为黄枫谷内门精英，何曾与男子有过如此亲密的接触？
下意识地便要挣扎。
“莫动。”北寒风的声音带着一种奇异的安抚力量，“你伤势太重，乱动会加重。”
他的臂膀稳健有力，怀抱并不温暖，甚至带着老人特有的微凉，但奇异地让人感到一种踏实。
白芷咬了咬下唇，放弃了挣扎，任由北寒风抱着。
她闭上眼，感受着耳边呼啸的风声——北寒风已施展御剑，抱着她快速离开了这片山谷。
约莫一炷香后，北寒风在一处隐蔽的山壁前停下。
他拨开藤蔓，露出后面洞口。
“暂在此处歇息。”他抱着白芷，钻了进去。

There was silence in the valley, only the voice of the North Cold Wind, "White Fairy, farewell and well" echoed in the air.
Bai Zhi's hand holding the sword slowly lowered, and the tip of the sword was dripping with blood.
"You..." She opened her mouth, her voice hoarse and dry due to injuries and shock, "Beihanfeng? You...hid your cultivation?"
Beihanfeng didn't answer immediately.
He first walked to Li Jian's body, pulled off the storage bag from his waist, and stuffed it into his arms.
Then, he picked up the soul-calling flag again, with a cold and heavy hand. After a brief feeling, he knew that the evil spirit of this thing was deep and beyond his control, so he threw it aside casually.
After doing all this, he turned around and looked at Bai Zhi.
"I got something by chance, so I don't dare to tell it publicly." His voice was hoarse and calm, and he couldn't hear too much emotion.
Occasional income?
Bai Zhi's heart was in turmoil again.
From a centenarian with withered Qi and blood, blocked meridians, and was judged to have lost his way to immortality, to a monk who has reached at least the seventh level of Qi refining, how can this be described as "occasional gains" in an understatement?
"Earth Vein Spiritual Essence," Bai Zhi took a deep breath, suppressed the surging blood and distracting thoughts, and said Shen: "This thing is needed by the sect, it is of great importance, you..."
"This thing is also a life-saving thing for the elderly." Bei Hanfeng interrupted her directly, with a calm but firm tone, "Fairy should understand that if my spiritual roots are not refined by this thing, I will eventually be like a mirror, and my path to immortality will be cut off."
Bai Zhi was silent.
Of course she understands what a heavenly and earthly spiritual creature like the Earthly Vein Spiritual Marrow, which can refine spiritual roots, means to an almost withered Heavenly Spiritual Root.
But the sect mission... She looked at Bei Hanfeng's determined eyes at this moment and knew that it was absolutely impossible for him to hand over his spiritual essence.
What's more, he just saved his own life.
After a moment, she seemed to have exhausted all her strength and slowly leaned against a rock. Her voice was a little tired: "I will report what happened today to the Ming Sect. I killed Li Jian with all my strength. As for the earth vein essence... I said it was accidentally destroyed in the fierce battle."
Bei Hanfeng took a deep look at her, then solemnly raised his hands and bowed deeply: "Fairy, I am so kind to you, Bei Hanfeng... Minggan Wu Nei."
Bai Zhi stared at Bei Hanfeng and wanted to say something, but at this moment, blood surged in her chest, and then she spit out another mouthful of blood.
"Fairy Bai!" Bei Hanfeng stepped forward and supported Bai Zhi, "Fairy Bai, are you injured?"
Bai Zhi waved her hand, took out a healing elixir and drank it, her pale face improved slightly.
"Thank you... Junior Brother Bei for coming to the rescue." She looked at Bei Hanfeng and changed her words with complicated eyes.
Those who have mastered the world of immortality are the first, and since Bei Hanfeng has the advanced level of Qi refining, the words "Junior Brother" acknowledge his status.
"The fairy's words are serious, it's a matter of duty." Bei Hanfeng supported Bai Zhi, glanced at the valley, and then looked at Bai Zhi: "Fairy Bai, it is not suitable to stay here for a long time. I will take you away first."
Bai Zhi nodded.
"I'm sorry, Fairy." Bei Hanfeng whispered, no longer hesitating, and picked up Bai Zhiheng with his arms.
Bai Zhi exclaimed, and a blush instantly appeared on her pale face. As an elite member of the Yellow Maple Valley inner sect, had she ever had such close contact with a man?
You have to struggle subconsciously.
"Don't move." Bei Hanfeng's voice carried a strange soothing power, "Your injury is too serious, and moving around will make it worse."
His arms were steady and strong, and his embrace was not warm, and even had a slight coolness unique to the old man, but it strangely made people feel at ease.
Bai Zhi bit her lower lip, gave up struggling, and let Bei Hanfeng hold her.
She closed her eyes and felt the whistling wind in her ears - Beihanfeng had used his sword to hold her and quickly left the valley.
After about a stick of incense, the cold north wind stopped in front of a hidden mountain wall.
He pushed aside the vines to reveal the hole at the back.
"Rest here for now." He hugged Bai Zhi and got in.
